## Log

- 2026-01-13: Added test dependencies (tempfile, assert_cmd, predicates) to Cargo.toml
- 2026-01-13: Implemented 14 unit tests for event replay logic in src/event.rs (derive_bug, read_events, append_event)
- 2026-01-13: Implemented 17 unit tests for bug state derivation in src/bug.rs (Status, Priority parsing, Bug::parse)
- 2026-01-13: Implemented 19 integration tests for CLI commands (init, new, list, show, update, approve, start, done, log)
- 2026-01-13: Created test fixtures directory with 3 sample bug JSONL files
- 2026-01-13: Added GitHub Actions CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) with test, clippy, and fmt jobs
